subject: Re: Lyra Labs - sandbox credit pathway and activation plan
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@lyralabs.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request — sandbox credits + July demo

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for taking a quick intro call yesterday. Lyra Labs is building a semantic search product for clinical research teams and we are preparing a 6-week pilot with one of our hospital partners (demo slated for 2026-07-01).

To make the pilot realistic we need a sandbox with the following:
- Hosted inference access (no PHI in pilot but we want to validate latency across regions)
- ~50k tokens/day peak, roughly 700k tokens over 6 weeks
- Temporary API keys + a short-term SLA for availability during the demo window

Can Redwood provide a provisional credit or trial extension to cover the 6-week pilot? An initial ballpark we had in mind was ~$10k of hosted credits — happy to adjust based on how you price consumption. We can share a short pilot scope and LOI if helpful.

Attached: Lyra_Pilot_Overview.pdf (one-pager)

Elena Park
Head of Partnerships
Lyra Labs
elena@lyralabs.ai
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@lyralabs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot request — sandbox credits + July demo

Thanks Elena — great to meet you yesterday. We can absolutely support a pilot like this and I appreciate the clear scope. A few quick clarifying questions that will help with internal approvals: 

- Expected peak concurrent requests / RPS during demo window (so we can size prefetched KV cache and batching)
- Do you expect any customer data residency requirements (EU/APAC)?
- Will you need Private (VPC) deployment or is hosted API sufficient for this phase?
- Procurement contact (for LOI/PO) and any billing constraints (PO only, net30, etc.)

If hosted works, I can provision provisional credits while we finalize MOU/LOI. Looping in Marissa for credits and Karthik for pricing/terms.

Proposed next step: 30-minute technical kickoff the week of Jun 22 so we can validate token burn and warm-up strategy. Does Jun 24 or Jun 25 work for your team?

Best,
Ava Chen
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Questions for pricing/ops:

— Ava
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Lyra Labs - sandbox credit request (pilot scope attached)

Thanks for the context. Approval notes below: 

- Offer: $8,000 hosted-credit, valid for 8 weeks from activation (covers the 6-week pilot + 2-week wrap-up).
- Conditions: credit released on receipt of LOI or PO (simple one-page LOI ok). Credit will be applied to hosted account and expires after 8 weeks.
- Milestone gating: 50% of credit up-front, remaining 50% released after successful demo on Jul 1 and short post-demo call to confirm token burn aligns with expectations.
- Activation steps:
  1) LOI/PO sent to procurement@redwood.ai
  2) CS team provisions sandbox and provisional API keys
  3) Technical kickoff (30m) to validate token burn and latency; recommend Jun 25 10:00am PT

Attachments: SOW-DRAFT.docx (optional starter SOW), MAP-activation.xlsx (mutual action plan template)

I also recommend reserving a small Dedicated burst slot for demo day (we can convert to hosted credits if not used). Marissa — please confirm quota/blocking on your end and whether we should reserve any GPU capacity.
